_meta.purpose: Seed file for mirror_upstream_keys — Praxis-wide upstream-archive trust anchors.
notes: PRA-158 #4c. Upstream archive keys (Ubuntu Archive, Debian, Rocky, Alma, CentOS Stream, RHEL) rotate periodically; we deliberately do NOT bake known keys into the codebase because a stale baked-in anchor is a security footgun. Each operator makes a deliberate trust decision per anchor.

To populate: paste armored PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCKs from authoritative sources (the distro's docs, package signing key page, or an existing trusted host's /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d / /etc/pki/rpm-gpg/) into the entries array as objects with name, armored_public_key, and optional notes.
To import: run scripts/seed-upstream-keys.py (airgap-friendly, file-only — never fetches anything). The script is idempotent: keys already in the table by fingerprint are skipped with a log line.
An empty entries array is a valid no-op — operators who don't enable verify_upstream_signature don't need any anchors.
